messages:
ali: spontaneous heads-up  there's a friendly footie match at the park 5pm. anyone want to form an office team? :soccer:

ben: i'm in if i can be goalie. low-stakes promise: i only dive for dramatic effect. :sweat_smile:

mai: signed. i'll bring an extra pair of cleats and sunscreen. also can we make shirts? cheap sharpie brigade.

zoe: shirts yes. colour suggestion: loud neon so runners don't collide with walkers.

sam: vote: pizza after? 50% split on toppings. tiny $3 pot for MVP (most dramatic slide tackle).

scorebot: RSVP form: https://forms.example/footie-5pm (please fill name + shirt size). pizza poll link posted.

ali: side-bet: last-minute winner prediction. $2 each. winner gets a souvenir penalty-kick trophy (aka paper cup).

ben: putting $2 on "Ben scores via accidental header". odds: very optimistic.

mai: i predict Zoe will score and immediately apologize to the ball. $2.

zoe: that's a public promise, mai. i accept and will practice my apology.

sam: pizza majority so far: pepperoni + veggie split. imma bring napkins and the dramatic playlist.

ali: note: park has lights but might be dim after 6:30. bring flashlights if you care about locating lost socks.

scorebot: weather check at 3pm. rain backup: indoor mini-game in conference room C (no cleats).

ben: also i nominate a halftime meme exchange. best goalkeeper gif gets extra MVP vote.

mai: sold. i will curate goalkeeper memes. prepare for shame and GIFs. :joy:

zoe: logistical ask: anyone with first-aid kit? i can bring band-aids but want a proper kit for turf burns.

sam: i have a kit. also triple-checked we're allowed to use the park field weekends. we are.

ali: final: meet at lobby at 4:40 to walk over. pizza order after by 7pm. see you there  come ready to cheer, slide, and maybe faintly regret choices. :grin:
